stimulus: Nowadays, parents are very conscious. (a) _____ the harmful effect of punishment (b) _____ children. It may lead (e) _____ fear and hatred of the person who punishes (f) _____ child. Again, if (g) _____ child is punished, it may lack initiative. It may also feel hostile (h) _____ others. So, rude (i) _____ behaviour gradually develops (j) _____ him.
